title: Cohomology of a finite boundary
statement:
Let $Z_0$ be finite over $k_0$ and let $\mathcal G$ be a
constructible Weil sheaf whose stalks have weights at most $w$. Then
$H_c^r(Z,\mathcal G)=0$ for $r\neq0$.

proof.text: For r < 0, unfold compact support as exact extension by zero followed by the right derived functor of pushforward along the chosen proper compactification. The exact functor sends a degree-zero sheaf to a degree-zero sheaf; Functor.isGE_rightDerivedFunctor_obj_singleFunctor and DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE give zero negative homology. WeilComplex.isZero_homologySheaf_obj_iff transfers this to the Weil cohomology sheaf. Global sections, forgetting adic coefficients, and coefficient restriction preserve zero objects; ModuleCat.subsingleton_of_isZero gives the required carrier subsingleton.

In the remaining case 0 < r, apply [lem-a1-finite-boundary-cohomology-positive] to obtain a zero Weil cohomology sheaf, then the same global-sections argument. The parent declaration is unchanged; this is a decomposition with a proved negative-degree branch and an open geometric upper-bound branch.
